password-manager.body:
**Offline password manager** — A small, focused password tool. Offline password manager does one job properly, runs offline, and keeps your data on your device.

**Why it exists**
Password is one of those small irritations that eats a little attention every
single day. This is a single-purpose tool for it: no setup, no sign-in, no
network calls. Open the page and it works.

**What the free edition does**
Everything you need for the job itself. It runs straight in the browser and
your data never leaves your device.

**Get it**
- Free: https://tbougnar.github.io/Slingshot-Tools/apps/password-manager-basic/

One new tool lands every month. Use `/vote` in the server to pick what comes
next.

## Unit converter

Converting units is routine work, but the tools for it often come with strings attached: an account

dev-converter.body:
Developers often need to convert units while staying offline and keeping their work private. Developer unit converter is a Windows tool built for that workflow: no account, no subscription, and no data sent off your device.

The free edition is available as a free download. The provided brief does not specify which conversion features are included in the free edition.

The full edition costs $3.00 and is a buy-once purchase: no account, no subscription, and your data never leaves your device. The brief does not list additional features added by the full edition beyond the one-time purchase.
